newsitem.title: USA: Andrew sees wireless growth, Q2 orders up.
newsitem.headline: Andrew sees wireless growth, Q2 orders up.

text.p: Andrew Corp said Thursday its orders increased 18 percent in the second quarter, and the company sees further growth in the wireless phone infrastructure and accessories market.

"Our operating team has achieved another quarter of excellent results," Floyd English, president, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement. "We are especially pleased with the quarter's strong order rate that was due in part to a number of significant longer-term contracts scheduled for shipment over the next four quarters."
Andrew said the contracts were for coaxial cable, antennas, broadcast systems, towers and services, mainly for the South American and Asian markets.

Andrew reported earnings for its second quarter ended March 31 of $0.28 a share versus $0.20 last year. Sales were $208.2 million, compared with $183.2 million. Orders for the quarter were $222.3 million, up from $188.8 million last year.
"As we look to the future we continue to see strong growth opportunities, especially in the wireless infrastructure and accessory markets," English said.

Andrew said its rise in orders and sales were due to a strong worldwide wireless phone infrastructure market. Personal Communications Services (PCS) infrastructure led sales growth in the United States, and international sales were also strong, particularly in Asia and Europe, the company said.
